diagnosis: Police transport consumed at most 0.25 seconds per rendered frame, slowing its approach on a roughly 1 FPS software renderer.
Character enrollment and final badge checks used five-second assertions before actual CPU inference requests had completed; recorded UI remained pending.
timingFollowUp.correction: Bounded elapsed-time transport with small movement steps; wait for real enrollment/assessment HTTP responses before UI assertions.
